_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
Ati kijibicha {player_id} Liar's Dice gurguddaa {num_players}-kijibicha keessa jirta.
Seerota:
- Yeroo kee, ati waan kana gochuu dandeessa:
  1) Kijibicha haaraa bayinaa olaanaa ykn facettaa olaanaa (ykn lachuu) kijibicha ammaa caalaa; '[Bid: 3, 4]' jedhamu,
  2) Kijibicha dhumaa '[Call]' jedhee galuu.

Yoo ati galuu:
  - Yoo lakkofsa facettaa ilaalchaa kijibichaa hundumaa kijibicha dhumaa caalaa ta'e, kijibicha dhumaa facettaa tokko dhaba.
  - Alaa, waamicha facettaa tokko dhaba.
Kijibicha facettaa 0 gahe moo'ame. Kijibicha hafee tokko moo'ata.

board.new_round:
Dhuma haaraa - Facettaa hafee: {dice_summary}
Facettaa kee ammaa: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Taphattuu {current_player_id} waamicha godhe! Qabee duraan {face_value} qabenyi dhugaa {count} dha, kanas < {quantity}.
Taphattuu {loser_id} (taphattuu bidde xumuraa) sikkarrii tokko dhabde.
call.caller_loses:
Taphattuu {current_player_id} waamicha godhe! Qabee duraan {face_value} qabenyi dhugaa {count} dha, kanas >= {quantity}.
Taphattuu {loser_id} (waamicha godhee) sikkarrii tokko dhabde.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Waamichi kan godhame, gatii utuu hin dhiheessin dura ture.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Sochii hin beekamne kijibicha '[Bid: X, Y]' ykn '[Call]' miti. Sochii ergamaa: {action}

bid_reason.identical: Kaffaltiin yeroo ammaa kaffalamuu wajjin wal fakkaata.
bid_reason.face_range: Gatiin mul'ataa 1 fi 6 gidduutti ta'uu qaba.

message.eliminated_invalid: Taphachiisaa {player_id} taphattuu hin taanee waliin dhabamsiifame.

outcome.win: Kijibicha {winner} moo'ate! Tarree kijibichoota kaasee hanga moo'ataa: {final_ranking}
